 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    points=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0=min(r for r,c in points); r1=max(r for r,c in points)
    c0=min(c for r,c in points); c1=max(c for r,c in points)
    # Frame colors encode two nested rectangular color bands.
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            depth=min(r-r0,c-c0,r1-r,c1-c)
            g[r][c]=4 if depth%2 else 2
    for r,c in points:
        if r0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1: g[r][c]=3
    return g
",
